title: When a UI-pass diff touches only `_test.go` files under internal/tui, tell the ui role in the brief that no renders are expected

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-185405-f675, project ork, item S531:

When a UI-pass diff touches only `_test.go` files under internal/tui, tell the ui role in the brief that no renders are expected

Evidence: S531 diff is only internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go; the render requirement had to be ruled out by hand
